title: Submit driver to the catalog
intro: The parameters below go to a moderator for review. The driver only appears in search once approved; your project does not change.

fields.sourceHint: Manufacturer datasheet, your own measurement… Cite the revision or date.
fields.email: Email to notify you of the decision
fields.emailHint: Used only to tell you whether the driver was approved or rejected, then erased.
fields.diameterHint: Commercial size of the loudspeaker, for example 12".
fields.trap: Do not fill in this field

errors.impedance: Enter only the impedance in ohms, from 0.5 to 64 (e.g. 4 or 3.2).

failure.alreadyInCatalog: This driver is already in the catalog (same manufacturer, model and variant). Look it up in search.
failure.alreadyPending: This driver is already under review. There is no need to submit it again.
failure.rateLimited: Too many submissions in a short time. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
failure.rateLimitedUnknown: Too many submissions in a short time. Try again later.
failure.verification: We could not confirm that you are not a robot. Try again.
failure.network: No connection to the server. What you typed was kept; try again.
failure.server: The server could not receive the submission. What you typed was kept; try again.
failure.invalid: The server rejected some fields. Check the notes below.

success.title: Submission received
success.review: Your driver goes through review and only appears in search once approved.
success.emailNotice: We will email you when there is a decision.

discard.title: Discard the submission?
discard.body: You typed data that has not been sent. Closing now discards it.

manual.title: Fill from the manual
manual.privacy: The PDF text is sent to an external AI service to read the parameters. The file is not stored.
manual.suspect: Check the manual: this value does not match the others.

warnings.review: Data was read automatically. Review it before submitting.
warnings.multiple_drivers: The manual seems to list more than one driver; we used the first one. Please check.
warnings.nothing_found: We found no Thiele-Small parameters in this PDF.
warnings.discarded: Some values in the manual were out of range and left blank: {{fields}}.

failure.unreadable: This PDF has no readable text (it may be an image). Fill in the fields by hand.
failure.invalidFile: Choose a PDF up to 10 MB and 30 pages.
failure.notPdf: The file must be a PDF.
failure.tooLarge: The PDF is larger than 10 MB.
failure.rateLimited: You have used manual filling several times. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
failure.rateLimitedUnknown: You have used manual filling several times. Try again later.
failure.unavailable: Filling from a manual is unavailable right now. You can still fill the fields by hand.
failure.providerFailed: We could not read the manual right now. Try again or fill the fields by hand.
failure.verification: We could not confirm you are not a robot. Try again.
failure.network: No connection to the server. What you typed was kept; try again.
failure.server: The server could not read the manual. What you typed was kept; try again.

manual.offline: Offline: reading the manual needs the server.
manual.subtitle: AI reads the datasheet and fills the empty fields. You review everything before submitting.
manual.dropHint: PDF up to 10 MB and 30 pages
